name: Soraka
title: the Starchild

Q.name: Starcall
Q.description: Soraka calls down a star, dealing 85/120/155/190/225 + 0.35×AP magic damage and Slowing by 30% for 1.5 seconds. Hitting an enemy champion grants Soraka Rejuvenation, which restores (varies) Health over 2.5 seconds and grants 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Move Speed decaying over the same duration.
Q.summary: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.

W.name: Astral Infusion
W.description: Soraka restores 90/110/130/150/170 + 0.5×AP Health to another allied champion. If Soraka is affected by Rejuvenation, the Health cost will be reduced by 80/85/90/95/100%, and the target will gain Rejuvenation for @Spell.SorakaQ:HoTDuration@ seconds.
W.summary: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.

E.name: Equinox
E.description: Soraka creates a starfield that deals 70/95/120/145/170 + 0.4×AP magic damage to champions. The field lingers for 1.5 seconds, Silencing enemies inside. When the zone disappears, champions inside the zone are Rooted for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 second(s) and take 70/95/120/145/170 + 0.4×AP magic damage.
E.summary: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.

R.name: Wish
R.description: Soraka calls upon divine powers, restoring 150/250/350 + 0.5×AP Health to all allied champions, regardless of distance. Healing is increased to (150/250/350 + 0.5×AP) × (1 + 0.5) on targets below 40% Health.
R.summary: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.

Passive.name: Salvation
Passive.description: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.
Passive.summary: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Healing support who pokes with Q to fuel W heals on allies. Silences with E and saves from anywhere with R.
profile.curveNote: Pokes with Q; heals through trades.

Q.notes: Delayed star; hitting a champion gives her heal over time.

W.notes: Heals an ally at cost of her health.

E.notes: Silences inside; roots those still in when it ends.

profile.windowAgainst: Grievous Wounds and all-in on her directly; she has no escape.
